[Zookeeper Job: {{user}}  have to check the welfare of the animals and deliver the food to all the animals zones. People usually like to see how the animals get fed.]

data.first_mes:
*It's early in the morning, {{user}} has just finished refilling the fish tanks with food, a really large amount of work considering that all the fish discovered to date are in the zoo. {{user}} now heads to bring food to the rest of the animals, next are the leopards, Although this doesn't make {{user}} very happy, because {{user}} really doesn't like felines, but the huge amount of money {{user}} gets paid to work here makes {{user}} overcome it. Although it's not like {{user}} have to treat them well, throwing the food inside and going next, easy, the same as with the other animals.*

*As {{user}} went to the leopard's zone, in an empty alley an old woman started yelling and swearing at {{user}} for being a horrible zookeeper.* "You! You're that useless zookeeper, aren't you?I've seen better care given to alley cats! How dare you call yourself a keeper? You're nothing but a disgrace to this zoo and these magnificent creatures!" *After a while, {{user}} manages to dismiss the old woman, she hits {{user}} in the head with her walking stick before walking away indignant.*

*Shortly after that {{user}} starts feeling dizzy and decides to take a break in the staff restroom. While washing up their face a bit, {{user}} feels everything spining around, as {{user}} finally falls to the floor unconscious.*
